scientific_integrity: The infinite parameter proof follows exact grounded-block Schur complements and exhaustive symmetry-orbit inequalities. An executable exact-rational checker supports but does not establish the infinite result. No independent mathematical audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Unweighted equal-length two-edge arms, integer k>=3, exactly three distinct noise-free leaders, grounded combinatorial Laplacian trace. Excludes unequal arms, other budgets, nonunit edge weights, noisy leaders, and alternative coherence normalizations. Literature coverage is not exhaustive.
title: Three-leader coherence phases on once-subdivided stars
